claims.title: Remote acoustic writing: renewable chemical contrast and capture before activation

quoted_fields.interface: The chemical model assumes ideal scavenging/replenishment and phenomenological conversion. The force model assumes isolated homogeneous spheres, small-particle linear incident acoustics, overdamped one-dimensional motion and cross-frequency averaging. No favorable property transfers between them.
quoted_fields.failure: A prescribed activation clock is not a measured cure or bond. Cavitation, walls, aggregates, streaming, actual field transmission, state sensing and three-dimensional confinement are outside the force model. Field exposure is not electrical energy.
